question: Which Indian state’s Pollution Control Board conducted the first-ever Plastic Waste Brand Audit?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Punjab Pollution Control Board (PPCB)** conducted the first-ever Plastic Waste Brand Audit in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The audit was conducted in six cities: **Mohali, Jalandhar, Ludhiana, Amritsar, Patiala, and Bathinda.**
 
• 14 major companies, including 4 multinational companies, were identified as the top contributors to hard-to-recycle plastic waste.
 
• These companies were responsible for approximately **59% of the non-recyclable plastic waste** in Punjab.
 
• The audit analyzed **11,810 plastic packets** and **6,991 kg of municipal waste** to identify the plastic waste sources.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Plastic Waste Brand Audit**__

 __
 
• First time in India, the audit targeted identifying and analyzing the plastic waste produced by specific brands.
 
• Focus was on identifying companies contributing to **non-recyclable plastic waste** and formulating strategies for reduction.
 
 
 
• **Role of PPCB**__
 
 
• Punjab Pollution Control Board (PPCB) aims to enhance monitoring and enforcement to tackle plastic pollution.
 
• Accountability for plastic pollution is being enforced, and companies have been directed to present clear, time-bound strategies.
